Dataset or source layer: Odense Municipality administrative boundary
Provider: Klimadatastyrelsen / DAGI municipal boundary; study extent for Odense Municipality
Access date: 2026-06-01 (analysis frame); retained through v1 re-analysis
Format and resolution: Polygon vector; municipal extent ≈ 304.37 km²; CRS EPSG:25832
Variables used: Municipality geometry; study-area identifier
Spatial processing: Projected to EPSG:25832; used as clip mask for all input layers
Final analytical role: Defines the functional urban–rural continuum analysis boundary and clipping extent

Dataset or source layer: 500 m hexagonal analysis tessellation
Provider: Constructed for this study (common AEE analysis unit)
Access date: 2026-06-01 (initial grid); n = 1,539 cells retained in v1/v2
Format and resolution: Regular hexagonal polygons; spacing 500 m; CRS EPSG:25832; key = hex_id
Variables used: hex_id; cell area (km²)
Spatial processing: Generated over the municipal extent; all indicators aggregated or joined by hex_id
Final analytical role: Common spatial support for multimodal accessibility, environmental, and equity indicators

Dataset or source layer: OpenStreetMap pedestrian network (OSMnx, network_type=walk)
Provider: OpenStreetMap contributors; retrieved via OSMnx / Overpass API
Access date: OSM snapshot at retrieval; accessibility GPKG dated 2026-06-01 (re-used 2026-07-29)
Format and resolution: Line network (NetworkX MultiDiGraph); Odense clip; CRS EPSG:25832
Variables used: Walkable edges and nodes; impedance = network length (m)
Spatial processing: Graph construction; multi-source Dijkstra from service destinations to hex centroids; snap thresholds ≈ 200–250 m
Final analytical role: Primary active-mobility accessibility indicator in the AEE feature space and GeoAI typology

Dataset or source layer: OpenStreetMap service amenities and destinations (POI / polygon tags)
Provider: OpenStreetMap contributors; retrieved via OSMnx / Overpass API
Access date: OSM snapshot at retrieval; analysis GPKG 2026-06-01
Format and resolution: Point and polygon features; clipped to Odense
Variables used: Daily-service taxonomy: food retail; health; education/childcare; food and drink; civic/daily services; recreation
Spatial processing: Category tagging; destination set for network accessibility; exponential distance decay a = exp(−d/700); walking speed 1.34 m/s; 15 min cutoff (≈ 1,206 m); category-weighted composite min–max scaled to 0–100
Derived indicator: Walking service accessibility, 15 min (walk_access_15m) and quintile classes
Final analytical role: Defines destination supply for walking accessibility; enters GMM clustering via walk_access_15m

Dataset or source layer: OpenStreetMap bicycle network (OSMnx, network_type=bike)
Provider: OpenStreetMap contributors; retrieved via OSMnx / Overpass API
Access date: OSM snapshot at retrieval; analysis GPKG 2026-06-01
Format and resolution: Line bicycle-compatible network; Odense clip
Variables used: Bikeable edges and nodes; impedance = network length (m)
Spatial processing: Dijkstra routing; cycling speed 15 km/h; decay a = exp(−d/1800); cutoffs 5 min (≈ 1,250 m) and 15 min (≈ 3,750 m); min–max scaled to 0–100
Derived indicator: Cycling service accessibility, 5 and 15 min (bike_access_5m, bike_access_15m)
Final analytical role: Cycling-domain accessibility; bike_access_15m prioritised in clustering feature set

Dataset or source layer: OpenStreetMap public-transport stops and stations
Provider: OpenStreetMap contributors; retrieved via OSMnx / Overpass API
Access date: OSM snapshot at retrieval; analysis GPKG 2026-06-01
Format and resolution: Point features (bus stop, platform, rail/tram station, transport hub)
Variables used: Stop/station locations and transport-mode tags
Spatial processing: First-/last-mile walking-network access on the pedestrian graph; speed 1.34 m/s; decay β = 1,000 m; cutoffs 10 min (≈ 804 m) and 20 min (≈ 1,608 m); composite = 0.5·all-stops + 0.5·category-weighted; no GTFS timetable routing
Derived indicator: PT stop-access potential, 10 and 20 min (pt_stop_access_10m, pt_stop_access_20m)
Final analytical role: Public-transport accessibility potential; pt_stop_access_20m prioritised in clustering feature set

Dataset or source layer: GeoDanmark natural / green land-cover classes (official_landcover_natural)
Provider: Klimadatastyrelsen & municipalities (GeoDanmark partnership); accessed via Datafordeler (GEODKV WFS) and Dataforsyningen
Access date: Downloaded 2026-07-29 (product currency per GeoDanmark registration, ~2023)
Format and resolution: Polygon vector; dissolved multipolygon for Odense; CRS EPSG:25832
Variables used: Natural/green classes (e.g. skov, vådområde, kratbevoksning and related)
Spatial processing: Clip to municipality; intersect with hexagons; area share = intersected area / hex area × 100
Final analytical role: Environmental benefit proxy; enters quality composites and clustering feature set

Dataset or source layer: GeoDanmark water / blue features (official_blue)
Provider: Klimadatastyrelsen & municipalities (GeoDanmark); Datafordeler (GEODKV) / Dataforsyningen
Access date: Downloaded 2026-07-29
Format and resolution: Polygon vector; CRS EPSG:25832
Variables used: Water bodies (e.g. sø, bassin and related water features)
Spatial processing: Clip; polygon–hex intersection; area share × 100
Final analytical role: Environmental amenity / blue-space component of environmental composites

Dataset or source layer: GeoDanmark built-up land-cover and settlement fabric (official_builtup)
Provider: Klimadatastyrelsen & municipalities (GeoDanmark); Datafordeler (GEODKV) / Dataforsyningen
Access date: Downloaded 2026-07-29
Format and resolution: Polygon vector; CRS EPSG:25832
Variables used: Built-up classes (e.g. bygning, bykerne, høj-/lavbebyggelse, erhverv)
Spatial processing: Clip; polygon–hex intersection; area share × 100
Final analytical role: Urban morphology / environmental pressure proxy; clustering and URC score input

Dataset or source layer: GeoDanmark road centre-lines (vejmidte / official_roads)
Provider: Klimadatastyrelsen & municipalities (GeoDanmark); Datafordeler (GEODKV) / Dataforsyningen
Access date: Downloaded 2026-07-29
Format and resolution: Line vector; CRS EPSG:25832
Variables used: Road geometry; trafikart / vejkategori attributes for major-road selection
Spatial processing: Filter to major roads (motorway, hovedrute, etc.); 50 m buffer; buffer ∩ hex / hex area × 100
Final analytical role: Transport-related environmental burden / exposure indicator; clustering input

Dataset or source layer: WDPA protected areas (Denmark extract) ∪ LBST §3 / areal nature
Provider: UNEP-WCMC Protected Planet; Landbrugsstyrelsen (LBST) via geodata.fvm.dk
Access date: WDPA DNK extract July 2026; LBST pull 2026-07-29
Format and resolution: Polygon vector; CRS EPSG:25832 after harmonisation
Variables used: Protected-area designation; §3 nature / areal polygons
Spatial processing: Union of WDPA and LBST layers; intersect with hexagons; area share × 100
Final analytical role: Ecological protection / semi-natural land component of environmental quality

Dataset or source layer: Multi-source environmental quality and burden composites (derived)
Provider: Constructed in this study from GeoDanmark, protected-land, and supporting surfaces
Access date: Computed 2026-07-29 (official env. pipeline) / multi-source index run
Format and resolution: Hexagon attribute table (500 m); scores scaled 0–100
Variables used: Weighted combination of green/blue/eco benefits and built-up/road (and supporting) pressures
Spatial processing: Hex-level weighted scoring; min–max normalisation; quintile classification for mapping
Derived indicator: Environmental quality index (env_quality_score); environmental burden index (env_burden_score)
Final analytical role: Core Environment-domain indicators; enter AEE feature space and GMM typology

Dataset or source layer: Statistics Denmark StatBank parish population (SOGN)
Provider: Statistics Denmark (Danmarks Statistik) — StatBank
Access date: SOGN extracts spanning 2022–2026 reference years (validation and mapping totals)
Format and resolution: Tabular counts linked to parish codes; geometries from DAWA/DAGI parish polygons
Variables used: Parish population totals (SOGN1 / SOGN10 series as available)
Spatial processing: Join counts to parish polygons; dasymetric allocation to BBR residential floor-area weights within parish; aggregate to 500 m hex
Final analytical role: Primary demographic control for density estimation and equity morphology

Dataset or source layer: Statistics Denmark StatBank postcode population and age bands (POSTNR / POSTNR1)
Provider: Statistics Denmark — StatBank
Access date: 2022–2026 extracts as available for Odense postcodes
Format and resolution: Tabular counts; postcode polygon geometries (DAWA/DAGI)
Variables used: Postcode population; age 0–14 and 65+ bands
Spatial processing: Allocate age bands with BBR residential weights; scale to municipal age structure; aggregate to hex
Derived indicator: Age structure shares (children_share; elderly_share); age vulnerability
Final analytical role: Supports age-vulnerability indicators (descriptive equity layer; not GMM inputs)

Dataset or source layer: Statistics Denmark StatBank municipal population control (FOLK1A)
Provider: Statistics Denmark — StatBank
Access date: 2026 FOLK1A control total used in demography v2 (≈ 213,431)
Format and resolution: Municipal tabular total (no hex geometry)
Variables used: Total municipal population (FOLK1A)
Spatial processing: Used as pycnophylactic control total after parish×BBR allocation and DST soft-constraint
Derived indicator: Scaled dasymetric population (hex sum ≈ municipal FOLK1A)
Final analytical role: Ensures demographic consistency with official municipal population totals

Dataset or source layer: BBR buildings — residential floor area (OD Buildings_2020)
Provider: Danish Building and Dwelling Register (BBR)
Access date: Building stock reference year 2020; used in demography v2 (2026-07-31)
Format and resolution: Address-linked building points / footprints with attributes; CRS EPSG:25832
Variables used: BYG_BOLIG_ (approved residential floor area, m²); building identifiers
Spatial processing: Ancillary weight for dasymetric redistribution of parish/postcode counts to buildings, then to hexagons
Derived indicator: Residential floor-area weights; dasymetric population and age surfaces
Final analytical role: Key ancillary layer for fine-scale demographic redistribution under the AEE equity domain

Dataset or source layer: DST Kvadratnet 1 km population density classes (extranet)
Provider: Statistics Denmark — Kvadratnet extranet
Access date: Density-class reference ~2019; used as soft constraint / validation 2026-07-31
Format and resolution: 1 km grid polygons; density interval classes (persons/km²), not paid person counts
Variables used: Density class intervals / class midpoints for validation
Spatial processing: Soft-constrain dasymetric estimates into DST density-class intervals; validate class agreement and rank correlation
Derived indicator: DST-constrained dasymetric density; validation metrics (class agreement ≈ 69%; Spearman ≈ 0.94)
Final analytical role: Independent spatial check on dasymetric population; morphology proxy retained in clustering

Dataset or source layer: Basisdata municipal age–sex structure (KOMM_TOT_21)
Provider: Municipal Basisdata_o extract / Statistics Denmark municipal totals
Access date: Reference year 2021 (age structure)
Format and resolution: Municipal tabular totals (no hex geometry)
Variables used: Age-group control totals for municipality
Spatial processing: Scale postcode×BBR age allocations to municipal age shares × FOLK ratio
Final analytical role: Municipal control for age-vulnerability construction (descriptive)

Dataset or source layer: Demographic vulnerability composites (derived)
Provider: Constructed in this study from dasymetric density and age/socio fields
Access date: Computed with demography v2 indicators (2026-07-31)
Format and resolution: Hexagon attribute table; scores 0–100; quintile classes
Variables used: Population density; age vulnerability share; socio-economic vulnerability share (where available)
Spatial processing: Min–max normalisation; weighted composite; quintile classification
Derived indicator: Demographic vulnerability index; age and socio-economic vulnerability classes
Final analytical role: Descriptive equity mapping and profiling; demographic vulnerability excluded from GMM inputs by design

Dataset or source layer: ESA CLIM4cities summer land-surface temperature (Sentinel-3 SLSTR)
Provider: ESA / Zenodo CLIM4cities (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20863040)
Access date: Scenes June–August 2020–2023; processed to hex 2026-07-29
Format and resolution: Raster ≈ 100 m; reprojected to EPSG:25832
Variables used: Land-surface temperature (°C); summer composite
Spatial processing: Zonal mean per hexagon (heat_mean); note: LST ≠ air temperature
Final analytical role: Supporting heat-exposure surface for environmental quality/burden composites

Dataset or source layer: Vejdirektoratet state-road traffic noise (Lden) — Støjkortlægning af statsveje 2022
Provider: Danish Road Directorate (Vejdirektoratet)
Access date: Mapping year 2022; downloaded 2026-07-29
Format and resolution: Polygon noise bands + derived 50 m raster; CRS EPSG:25832
Variables used: Lden noise levels along state roads
Spatial processing: Intersect/zonal statistics per hex; state roads only
Final analytical role: Supporting acoustic burden indicator in environmental composites

Dataset or source layer: Open-Meteo / CAMS regional NO₂ air-quality surface
Provider: Open-Meteo Air Quality API (Copernicus CAMS-based); interim product
Format and resolution: Raster approximately hex-compatible after resampling; CRS EPSG:25832
Variables used: NO₂ concentration proxy
Spatial processing: Zonal mean per hexagon (air_pollution_mean)
Final analytical role: Interim environmental pressure input; intended for replacement by DCE AirGIS / “Luften på din vej” when available

Dataset or source layer: DAWA / DAGI parish and postcode geometries
Provider: Klimadatastyrelsen — DAGI / DAWA address and administrative geometries
Access date: Used with StatBank joins in demography v2 (2026-07-31)
Format and resolution: Polygon vector (parish SOGN; postcode POSTNR); CRS EPSG:25832
Variables used: Administrative zone codes and boundaries
Spatial processing: Spatial join of StatBank tables to zone polygons; interface for dasymetric allocation
Derived indicator: Demographic source zones for dasymetric mapping
Final analytical role: Enables zone-to-building-to-hex population transfer under the equity domain

Dataset or source layer: Non-Western-origin / migration-origin grid extract (ikkevestlig / related)
Provider: Municipal / Basisdata_o migration GIS extract (Odense)
Access date: Source year AAR_2021; retained on disk but not used in v1/v2
Format and resolution: 1 km grid polygons
Variables used: Non-Western-origin / related origin counts
Spatial processing: None in the published pipeline (layer not joined to hex indicators)
Final analytical role: Explicitly excluded from indicators, vulnerability indices, and GeoAI clustering by study design
